scientific limitations/integrity: The claim is restricted to equation (24) as printed, interpreted as an Itô SDE with constant additive Brownian terms and no boundary mechanism. It proves failure of nonnegative-state invariance and of stochastic-equilibrium status for the deterministic disease-free state under positive noise. It does not rule out an unconstrained Euclidean diffusion or a stationary law outside the biological state space.
title: Additive compartment noise destroys positivity and the stochastic disease-free equilibrium
